text: ポケモンずかんの　ページが　きに　なるんでな！

structure.jp: ポケモンずかんの　ページが

structure.en: are on my mind, you see!

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので, shortened here to んで, gives a reason, like 'because'; な softens it. きに　なるんでな = 'because it's on my mind, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜がきになる
patterns.span: ページが　きに　なる
patterns.explanation: きになる says something keeps coming to your mind; the thing gets が. ページが　きに　なる = 'I'm curious about the pages'.
